newsitem.title: USA: Vertex Communications to buy TIW Systems.
newsitem.headline: Vertex Communications to buy TIW Systems.

text.p: Vertex Communications Corp said Monday it reached a definitive agreement to acquire TIW Systems Inc, a manufacturer of earth station antennas and communications networking products.
Terms call for Vertex to pay $7.8 million in cash and 574,359 shares of its common stock for all of the outstanding common stock of TIW, it said.
The transaction is subject to approval by TIW shareholders and other conditions, it added.
If the conditions are met, it said it anticipates completing the transaction by June 11.
Vertex said it plans to include TIW's operating results in its consolidated financial statements from the date of closing.
TIW had $41.3 million of revenues in 1996 and, as of April, had more than $20 million in backlog of unfilled orders.

Vertex said the acquisition would raise its consolidated revenues by about $8-$10 million for its current fiscal year ending September 30, with no dilution to earnings anticipated over the same period.
